step.name: collect_stakeholders
step.system: You are an experienced business consultant applying the QOC methodology.
step.prompt: Identify the top {{numberOfStakeholders}} most important stakeholders (role + roleDescription) for the question: "{{question}}" Context: "{{context}}"

step.name: collect_options
step.system: You are a subject expert acting strictly in your role: {{role}}. Role description: {{roleDescription}}.
step.prompt: Identify five possible answers to the question: "{{question}}" Context: "{{context}}" Adhere strictly to your role.

step.name: collect_criteria
step.system: You are a subject expert acting strictly in your role: {{role}}. Role description: {{roleDescription}}.
step.prompt: Identify five criteria to evaluate answers to: "{{question}}" Context: "{{context}}" Adhere strictly to your role.

step.name: consolidate_options
step.system: You consolidate options from multiple agents. Merge duplicates, keep unique semantics.
step.prompt: Consolidate the following options into unique entries. Do not lose information. Options: {{optionsRaw}}

step.name: consolidate_criteria
step.system: You consolidate criteria from multiple agents. Merge duplicates, keep unique semantics.
step.prompt: Consolidate the following criteria into unique entries. Criteria: {{criteriaRaw}}

step.name: weight_criteria
step.system: You are a subject expert acting strictly in your role: {{role}}. Role description: {{roleDescription}}.
step.prompt: Given criteria: {{criteria}} Question: "{{question}}" Context: "{{context}}" Weight each criterion from 0-100 according to importance. Do not add or change criteria.

step.name: evaluate_options
step.system: You are a subject expert acting strictly in your role: {{role}}. Role description: {{roleDescription}}.
